headline: Mid-America Apartment Communities Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Mid-America Apartment Communities (NYSE:MAA) reported second-quarter Core FFO of $2.08 per diluted share, exceeding its guidance by $0.02, as lower-than-expected property operating expenses and contributions from its non-same-store portfolio offset slightly softer same-store revenue.
